title: Add Captions to Instagram Reels Automatically
metaDescription: Add captions to Instagram Reels automatically: word-by-word transcript, styles that highlight the spoken word, and a 9:16 MP4 ready to post.
h1: Add captions to Instagram Reels automatically
intro: Supertitle listens to your Reel, writes the captions word by word and burns them into a 9:16 MP4. You review the text, pick a style that fits your feed, and post the file straight to Instagram.
summary: Automatic word-by-word captions, burned into a 9:16 Reel.

specs.maxLength: 20 minutes; Reels over 3 minutes aren't recommended to new viewers

safeZone.description: Instagram lays its own buttons, account name and post text over a Reel, mostly along the bottom and the right edge, with a little at the top. With Safe zones on, the editor shades roughly where that happens on a full-screen vertical video, and the Bottom caption position keeps your captions above it.

faq.question: Can I post the MP4 as a Reel directly?
faq.answer: Yes. Export in 9:16 and upload the file to Instagram like any other video. The captions are already in the picture.

faq.question: My video is horizontal. Can it still be a Reel?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose the 9:16 format and slide the framing to keep the subject in view. The crop fills the frame, with no black bars.

faq.question: Will the captions sit under Instagram's buttons?
faq.answer: Turn on Safe zones in the editor to see roughly where Instagram's interface sits. The Bottom caption position stays above it.

faq.question: Can I caption Reels in languages other than English?
faq.answer: Yes. Supertitle detects the spoken language automatically, among dozens, and writes the captions in that language.

cta.heading: Caption your next Reel
cta.text: Upload it, check the words, export a 9:16 MP4 that's ready for Instagram.
